audit_scope: Batch 8_8 experimental-unit semantics and admissible claim boundary

resolved_experimental_unit.rationale: Author correspondence clarifies that plates and exp8 sequencing runs are technical structures, while the exact independent collection event or batch identity for each cell was not retained.

technical_hierarchy.role: cell-level biological observation nested within incompletely documented collection rounds
library-preparation plate label; not an independent biological experiment
pooled library-preparation experiment containing cells collected across multiple rounds
sequencing run or flow cell; technical measurement repetition
row used in exploratory mCherry.log.slope analysis

unresolved_metadata.field: per-cell collection day or extraction round
unresolved_metadata.impact: Prevents reconstruction of independent collection events and day-related confounding.
Prevents a defensible biological grouping key for pseudobulk or leave-group-out validation.
Leaves an unresolved technical path between imaging conditions and phenotype measurement.

pseudoreplication_findings.finding: Cells cannot be treated as independent biological replicates when collection-event nesting is unknown.
Plate labels represent technical library-preparation containers and cannot define biological folds.

admissible_analyses.reason: Useful for describing the observed cells when nesting and uncertainty are stated explicitly.
The observed association may generate hypotheses but lacks established independent biological replication.
Can reveal dependence on a technical container but cannot demonstrate biological generalization.
Plate is not a defensible biological grouping key.
The dataset does not establish independent biological replication, intervention assignment, or tissue-level response.

descriptive.reason: Descriptions are limited to the observed cells and documented technical structure.

association.reason: Only exploratory within-dataset association is supportable.

prediction.reason: No independent biological validation set is available.

generalization.reason: Independent biological units and external replication are not established.

causal.reason: No randomized or otherwise identifiable intervention contrast is present.

tissue.reason: Cell-level repository observations do not establish tissue-level effects.

clinical_therapeutic.reason: No clinical evidence, therapeutic intervention, safety assessment, or authorized translational study is present.

next_valid_action: Locate an independent dataset with documented biological grouping or obtain additional independently collected biological replicates through an authorized partner laboratory.

safety_status.notes: This audit does not authorize physical manipulation of cells, tissues, organisms, or patients.
